text:
Slow round or not, we are grateful for your detailed note and we have reviewed the complaint regarding the handling of your companion animal, the disruption to your journey, and the delay in the support you expected from Aurelia Skyways. We understand that the central concern is the distress caused when your pet was not managed with the care and clarity you were promised, and that this left you frustrated and uncertain about the next steps.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk takes such reports seriously. We have checked the record, spoken with the relevant ground team, and confirmed that the matter should have been handled with greater care and better communication. Your account has been added to our case file, and the service lapse will be addressed with the staff involved. We are also reviewing the boarding checks and handoff procedures so that travelers and pets receive steadier guidance before departure and calmer support at the gate.

If an injury occurred, the claim will be processed under our standard guest care provisions. <<FACT F113>> Please keep any veterinary note, handling report, and travel documents together, as these help us move the review forward without avoidable delay. If there was an escape in transit, the claim must be raised within the required window. <<FACT F120>> Please include a clear timeline, the airport location, and any witness details that may assist our assessment.

We appreciate the patience required to raise a concern of this kind, and we do not dismiss the strain it places on both traveler and animal. Aurelia Skyways expects better than what you described, and we will continue to press for a cleaner process, firmer supervision, and more respectful communication. Your feedback has been noted at the proper level, and the file will remain open until the review is complete and the next response is issued.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
